title: Nectanebo
summary: Nectanebo is dated in Raleigh's chronological table (1617), column Aegypt, by a yeere of the World. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person.
description: Added from the Raleigh import (The History of the World, 1617). Raleigh is display-only. He gives a yeere of the World, not a BC year, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: Calculated from printed figures. No tier 1–4 birth, no tier reign start, and no provisional year. Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 3645. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 3645 = 388 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad. A printed year for this person would replace it.

reign.note: Year cell "4327 3645". To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 18 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row. Column: Aegypt..
